# VariantPicker

Size or colour selection for one product, as a radio group with a single selected pill that glides between options.

`IK.VariantPicker` · Shopping

## Use

```jsx
<IK.VariantPicker options={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="IK.VariantPicker" options="{{…}}"></x-import>
```
